package.name: go2_remote_controller
package.description: Everything that commands the physical Go2: the web teleop bridge, the Unitree sport-mode client, the RL policy runtime, and the FastAPI dashboard. Depends on the Unitree SDK, so it only builds where that SDK is present (the Jetson / the robot's dev machine). Split out from the former go2_remote_connection package so that recording and replay tooling — which needs none of this — can be built and run on a laptop.
